item.title: Devotion
item.description: Devotion by Dolce & Gabbana. Candied citrus, orange blossom, and vanilla create a luminous citrus-gourmand fragrance. Authentic, factory-sealed Eau de Parfum, 100ml.

item.title: Dylan Blue Pour Femme
item.description: Dylan Blue Pour Femme by Versace. Blackcurrant, green apple, rose, jasmine, musk, and white woods feel fresh and polished. Authentic, factory-sealed Eau de Parfum, 100ml.

item.title: Not a Perfume
item.description: Not a Perfume by Juliette Has a Gun. A minimalist Cetalox composition with clean musky, woody, and amber facets. Authentic, factory-sealed Eau de Parfum, 100ml.

item.title: Crystal Noir Eau de Toilette
item.description: Crystal Noir Eau de Toilette by Versace. Cardamom, gardenia, orange blossom, amber, sandalwood, and musk feel dark and sensual. Authentic, factory-sealed Eau de Toilette, 90ml.
